input.summary: Make the liability cap mutual at 12 months' fees and place indemnity, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap.
input.comment: [Playbook] We need a mutual cap: as drafted only Licensor is capped (at one half of amounts paid) while Licensee's liability is unlimited, which is below our walk-away floor. We have moved to our fallback position of a mutual cap of 12 months' fees and confirmed that indemnification, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and willful misconduct sit outside the cap.

ops.oldText: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
ops.newText: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE FEES PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.

ops.text: THE CAP IN SECTION (b) SHALL NOT APPLY TO, AND EACH PARTY'S LIABILITY SHALL BE UNCAPPED FOR, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS, AND ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.
